_readme: Named gates. Coordinates are existing OSM gate nodes or OSM road/building vertices at the campus edge. Official numbers come from the VIT Office of Students' Welfare campus map (naming only — not traced off the scan as ground truth). School and department entries (anchored to their host building) imported from rugbedbugg/VIT-CampusMap.
_source: OpenStreetMap (geometry) + VIT OSW campus map (gate numbers) + rugbedbugg/VIT-CampusMap (schools)

items.name: Gate 1
items.desc: OSM barrier=gate next to the Main Gate Fountain, on the Katpadi-road side of campus. Numbered Gate 1 on the OSW campus map.

items.name: Gate 1A
items.desc: OSM barrier=gate on the west campus wall, next to CDMM / Health Centre — the side entrance paired with Gate 1.

items.name: MH Special Mess
items.desc: Men's hostel special mess (MessIT). Placed at the north hostel mess cluster next to OSM Darling SPL Mess.

items.name: MH Veg Mess
items.desc: Men's hostel vegetarian mess (MessIT). Placed at the north hostel mess cluster next to OSM PR Caterers.

items.name: MH Non-Veg Mess
items.desc: Men's hostel non-veg mess (MessIT). Placed at the north hostel mess cluster next to OSM PR Caterers Special Mess.

items.name: LH Special Mess
items.desc: Ladies' hostel special mess (MessIT). Placed at the south ladies' hostel cluster (OSM N Block).

items.name: LH Veg Mess
items.desc: Ladies' hostel vegetarian mess (MessIT). Placed at the south ladies' hostel cluster (OSM N Block).

items.name: LH Non-Veg Mess
items.desc: Ladies' hostel non-veg mess (MessIT). Placed at the south ladies' hostel cluster (OSM N Block).

items.name: Gate 2A
items.desc: West-south campus edge on an OSM service road, south of GDN/CDMM. Numbered Gate 2A on the OSW campus map.

items.name: Gate 3
items.desc: OSM barrier=gate where the south primary road meets campus, south of the ladies' hostel / CDMM. Numbered Gate 3 on the OSW campus map.

items.name: Gate 3A
items.desc: OSM residential-road vertex on the south campus edge, just east of Gate 3. Numbered Gate 3A on the OSW campus map.

items.name: Gate 5
items.desc: OSM unclassified-road vertex on the east campus edge, north-east of MGB / VIT Fields. Numbered Gate 5 on the OSW campus map.

items.name: Gate 11
items.desc: OSM barrier=gate at the south end of the long access road toward PRP / SJT Ground. Numbered Gate 11 on the OSW campus map.

items.name: Gate 11A
items.desc: South vertex of the OSM Perl Research Park footprint — the inner end of the Gate 11 access road. Numbered Gate 11A on the OSW campus map.
